panel_description_zh: 中近景平视，李斌坐在电脑前（电脑椅）；头半抬看妻子方向；眼睛微微睁开一条缝（疲惫闭眼的被叫醒变体）；嘴微张（说话中）；表情疲惫闭眼。

dialogue_or_narration.speaker: 李斌
dialogue_or_narration.text_zh: 今天是我的生日你知道吗？…………啊?不是吧，我记得过两天啊。

prompt_en: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, naturalistic proportions. Eye-level medium close-up of a 30-something East Asian Chinese man sitting in an office chair at a small desk in the guest bedroom, his head half-raised looking toward the off-frame wife direction. Exhausted eyes with the slightest slit of an opening — eyelids only barely raised showing a thin sliver of dark brown iris, inner ends of the eyebrows still pulled up and pinched together in the tired furrow, lips slightly parted mid-speech, dark circles under the eyes very visible, clean-shaven jaw with no stubble, short black slightly messy side-swept hair. Wearing a loose grey cotton crew-neck t-shirt. A computer monitor glows cool blue-white on the desk in front of him. Cool blue-grey ambient bedroom light plus the monitor glow. Mood: the half-asleep response, the husband's mind just catching up to the question. Text watermark 'P16-PN03' in the bottom-right corner.
negative_prompt_en: fully open alert eyes, smiling, tears, wife visible in the frame, decorative hallway art, daylight from a window, second character, romantic soft lighting, exaggerated cartoonish sweat drops, dramatic shadows
